# Research Record Template (PRD §44)

```text
Question: [Specific technical, API, or legal question investigated]
Date: [ISO Date]
Source: [Authoritative URL or Standard Reference]
Source Type: [Tier 1: Official Docs | Tier 2: Standards | Tier 3: Repos]
Finding: [Exact technical behavior verified]
Evidence: [Verbatim quote, code snippet, or benchmark command output]
Confidence: [HIGH | MEDIUM | ASSUMPTION]
Applicability: [Direct impact on this project]
Limitations: [Known constraints or rate limits]
Expiration Risk: [Likelihood of this information changing]
Related Decision: [Link to ADR or PRD requirement ID]
```
